products.name: macOS Compliance & Conditional Access for Zero-Trust Access — Commercial
products.short_description: Tie macOS device compliance to Conditional Access — Mac-specific signals gating resource access under Zero-Trust — so only trusted, compliant Macs get in, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Let only compliant, trusted Macs reach corporate resources

A Mac shouldn't reach corporate resources just because someone has the password. This solution builds macOS device compliance tied to Conditional Access — the Mac-specific compliance signals (encryption, OS version, firewall, Defender risk) feeding named Conditional Access policies — so only trusted, compliant Macs get in, under Zero-Trust principles, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how macOS compliance signals map to Conditional Access, the Zero-Trust model for Macs, and the standard deployment approach.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Intune compliance, Entra Conditional Access, device-based CA prerequisites, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named macOS compliance policy (encryption, OS, firewall, Defender risk), map it to a named Conditional Access policy, assign to a pilot, validate that non-compliant Macs are blocked, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — compliance/CA discovery, per-device compliance + access validation, a compliance + access-decision report, safe remediation, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (compliant → allowed; non-compliant → denied) plus Best Practices for grace and Zero-Trust rollout.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Only compliant, trusted Macs reach corporate resources — compliance signals wired to Conditional Access under Zero-Trust — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACCA-Discovery.ps1 — inventory enrolled Macs, macOS compliance policies, and CA policies (Microsoft Graph)
    • MACCA-Remediation.ps1 — safe, WhatIf-by-default fixes for common macOS compliance gaps (Microsoft Graph)
    • MACCA-Report.ps1 — per-Mac compliance state mapped to the access decision (Microsoft Graph)
    • MACCA-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/update the pilot or rollout group from the Mac inventory (Microsoft Graph)
    • MACCA-Validation.ps1 — pre-enforcement check: pilot Macs compliant + Entra-registered, break-glass excluded (Microsoft Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
